hero.title: Collect Feedback That Matters
hero.subtitle: Build better products with a feedback platform your users will love. Organize, prioritize, and ship features that drive growth.

features.title: Everything You Need to Manage Feedback

collaborative.title: Collaborative Boards
collaborative.description: Create public or private boards where your team and users can submit, vote, and discuss ideas.

customizable.title: Fully Customizable
customizable.description: Match your brand with custom themes, colors, and fonts. Add your own CSS for complete control.

embeddable.title: Embeddable Widget
embeddable.description: Embed feedback boards directly on your website with a simple JavaScript snippet.

multilingual.title: Multilingual Support
multilingual.description: Reach a global audience with support for multiple languages including English, Spanish, French, and German.

richText.title: Rich Text Editor
richText.description: Format your feedback with a powerful rich text editor. Add links, lists, and emphasis to your posts.

attachments.title: File Attachments
attachments.description: Attach images, documents, and other files to provide context and clarity to your feedback.

notifications.title: Email Notifications
notifications.description: Stay informed with automatic email notifications when users submit feedback or when features ship.

step1.title: Create Your Board
step1.description: Sign up and create a feedback board in seconds. Customize it to match your brand.

step2.title: Collect Feedback
step2.description: Share your board link or embed it on your site. Users can submit and vote on ideas.

step3.title: Ship Features
step3.description: Mark feedback as shipped and automatically notify your users. Keep them in the loop.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.subtitle: Start free for 3 months, then choose a plan that works for you
